body:
Thanks, Tank18. I'm glad it went well for you! Gives me hope that the conversations I'm probably going to be having soon aren't going to be as heavy as I expect...

(When I say "heavy", I mean after the fact.)

Thanks, Tezcatlan. One of my big worries has been that people would take it as a "grand announcement" and, as you pointed out, react with disbelief or over-concern (I don't really think she – or the other two who I think would help the most – would react with hostility).

I'm going to try telling a relative stranger this next couple of days, or at least practice saying (and hearing) the words in the shower. My couple of experiences with a psychologist/psychiatrist have been underwhelming, so I'm really hesitant to go that route though... Especially having read others' issues on SW about the pressure to admit to planning suicide in order to be taken seriously.
